events.price_note: $15 suggested donation; pay what you want
events.title: BYOB (Bring Your Own Beamer) Pop-Up Projector Show
events.why: Rafaël Rozendaal’s BYOB format turns Gray Area into a one-night garden of generative visuals, hardware contraptions, and moving light — exactly the hands-on art-tech room Deliria2 calibrated against.

events.title: On Speculative Futures: Radhika Singh with Omar Zahzah
events.why: A genre-fiction talk that treats speculative imagination as a tool against surveillance and empire — the critical-speculative vein that runs through the whole taste profile.

events.title: Partial Lunar Eclipse Watch Party
events.why: Live astronomer commentary plus outdoor deck viewing of a real partial lunar eclipse peaking at 9:13pm — odd, free-feeling, and genuinely outside the usual event calendar.

events.title: Black August Film Screening: The Strike
events.why: Not a generic screening: the Pelican Bay hunger-strike doc is framed by a panel, community dinner, healing sessions, and letter writing — a full resistance-culture evening.

events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Lithuanian folk forms meet experimental guitar and an Oakland composer returning to acoustic piano for a solo album release — a properly sidelong Friday-night experimental bill.

events.price_note: Tickets via Gray Area; two seated performances at 2:30pm and 6pm doors
events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World premiere of a hybrid VR/contemporary-dance/drag work exploring queer worldbuilding and mixed-reality embodiment — a direct Gray Area art-tech performance in the Deliria2 lineage.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: EastSide Arts Alliance’s annual Chicano Moratorium block party with DJ La Femme Papi, tacos, facepainting, and screenprinting — a grounded East Oakland community festival.

events.price_note: $5; all ages, no alcohol or drugs
events.title: 924 Gilman 40th Birthday Gallery
events.why: A photography exhibit and vendor market celebrating 40 years of the volunteer-run all-ages punk venue that launched Green Day — pure DIY institution history.

events.price_note: Festival passes and individual program tickets available
events.title: CROSSROADS 2026: San Francisco Cinematheque Festival at Gray Area
events.why: 49 works of avant-garde film, video, and performance by 52 artists across 8 programs, including JG Thirlwell live-scoring Harry Smith’s Heaven and Earth Magic — a flagship experimental-cinema event at the benchmark venue.
